## Notes

Erratum on place attributions. The Round 11 audit describes the place attributions field in session 1 cassette 02 as having come back null. The parsed body of that cassette carries no attributions key at all, and the word appears only inside the request field mask. Two details replies thus return a body without the field, and the fixture pins assert the absence of the key. The historical round documents stand as written, and this note rides beside them where a reader will find it.

The legacy hand built place details fixture carries a populated example attributions list. It is cited in the manifest only as authored decode coverage for the typed place attributions model, never as live evidence and never as a pin for case P14.

Redaction applies to every recorded fixture wherever review or photo author identity paths appear, and the manifest names each redacted path per fixture.
